sections.description: Groundedness and quality observations remain separate unless Gate 18.1 explicitly admits same-family comparison.

metrics.scope: Human-reviewed claim/citation support over the first frozen real run.
metrics.derivation: 11 supported claims divided by 13 emitted reviewed claims.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Phase 7 human-reviewed claim supportedness; distinct from Phase 8 hybrid groundedness.

metrics.scope: Six-case Gate 8.4 hybrid baseline; metric semantics frozen by the Gate 8 evaluation contract.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Gate 8 semantic-groundedness metric under its frozen hybrid evaluation contract.

metrics.scope: Frozen six-case direct Bedrock single-agent reasoning baseline.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Passed-case counts for the frozen six-case reasoning family; topology/runtime context must remain visible.

metrics.scope: Frozen six-case two-model comparison used to evaluate added topology value.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Passed-case counts for the frozen six-case reasoning family; topology/runtime context must remain visible.

metrics.scope: Authenticated AgentCore replay of the frozen Phase 11 six-case corpus.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Passed-case counts for the frozen six-case reasoning family; topology/runtime context must remain visible.

sections.description: Latency observations retain their transport/provider/runtime surface and may not be normalized across unlike boundaries.

metrics.scope: Median Bedrock provider latency over the six direct reasoning calls.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Phase 11 and Phase 12 provider medians are the explicit same-semantics comparison preserved by Phase 12.

metrics.scope: Per-case provider-latency median used by the artifact's explicit Phase 11 comparison.
metrics.derivation: Median of per-case provider latency after combining the bounded triage/specialist stages for each case.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Phase 11 and Phase 12 provider medians are the explicit same-semantics comparison preserved by Phase 12.

metrics.scope: Six-case authenticated HTTP/SigV4 transport elapsed sum; includes a different boundary from direct provider latency.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Authenticated AgentCore HTTP/SigV4 transport elapsed sum; not direct Bedrock provider latency.

metrics.scope: In-process/offline client elapsed sum; not network latency.
metrics.comparison_semantics: In-process A2A client elapsed sum; not network latency.

metrics.scope: Single bounded read-only Inspector discovery run in one dev account/Region.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Single bounded Inspector read-only client elapsed time.

sections.description: Token and cost evidence preserves measured, derived, unmeasured and not-applicable classifications without hidden zero normalization.

metrics.scope: Aggregate model token usage for the six-case direct reasoning baseline.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Total model-token volume for the Phase 11/12 six-case reasoning comparison.

metrics.scope: Aggregate triage plus specialist token usage.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Total model-token volume for the Phase 11/12 six-case reasoning comparison.

metrics.scope: Gate 8.4 baseline did not produce a complete USD cost measurement.
metrics.reason: The canonical Gate 8.4 artifact explicitly records cost.status=unmeasured and value=null.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Gate 8 complete USD cost is explicitly unmeasured.

metrics.scope: Six-case direct Bedrock inference estimate using run token evidence and contemporaneously verified rates.
metrics.derivation: Measured input/output token counts multiplied by verified 2026-09-07 US geographic cross-Region per-million-token rates.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Derived Bedrock inference costs for the Phase 11/12 six-case reasoning comparison.

metrics.scope: Six-case two-model inference estimate using measured token counts and verified rates.
metrics.derivation: Measured triage and specialist token counts multiplied by verified 2026-09-08 US geographic cross-Region rates and summed.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Derived Bedrock inference costs for the Phase 11/12 six-case reasoning comparison.

metrics.scope: Bounded experiment total; not a monthly or production estimate.
metrics.derivation: AgentCore runtime component plus Bedrock inference component for the single bounded experiment.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Derived total for the single AgentCore experiment; not monthly or production cost.

metrics.scope: No monthly production extrapolation is supported by the single bounded experiment.
metrics.reason: The canonical runtime artifact deliberately records monthly_extrapolation=null.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Monthly AgentCore cost is deliberately unmeasured and remains null.

metrics.scope: The retained A2A experiment is deliberately local/offline and creates no AWS runtime.
metrics.reason: A cloud-runtime cost metric is not applicable to an in-process experiment with zero new AWS resources; the source artifact's 0.0 incremental AWS field must not be reinterpreted as a measured cloud bill.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Cloud-runtime cost is not applicable to the local/offline A2A experiment.

metrics.scope: The closeout artifact contains no complete cost measurement for the Inspector discovery experiment.
metrics.reason: No canonical Phase 16 evidence field establishes a complete experiment USD cost; absence must remain UNMEASURED rather than zero.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Complete Inspector experiment USD cost is unmeasured.

sections.description: Observed no-execution outcomes are retained as contract evidence rather than converted into capability success rates.

metrics.scope: The frozen evaluation stops before capability execution; zero is an observed contract outcome, not a capability success rate.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Observed capability-execution counts under frozen no-execution evaluation contracts; not a success-rate metric.

metrics.scope: The comparison intentionally stops before capability execution.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Observed capability-execution counts under frozen no-execution evaluation contracts; not a success-rate metric.

metrics.scope: Runtime experiment contract explicitly forbids capability execution.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Observed capability-execution counts under frozen no-execution evaluation contracts; not a success-rate metric.

sections.description: Runtime evidence, security regression scope, telemetry controls and recovery controls are descriptive operational dimensions, not model-quality scores.

metrics.scope: ListFindings returned zero records for the measured account/Region/time.
metrics.comparison_semantics: ListFindings record count for the measured account/Region/time.

metrics.scope: Deterministic offline attacker-oriented boundary suite.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Deterministic attacker-oriented regression case count; not model quality.

metrics.scope: Retained Powertools Lambda handlers covered by explicit content-minimization controls.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Powertools Lambda handlers covered by the content-minimization control.

metrics.scope: Retained Scheduler delivery retry budget.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Configured Scheduler retry budget; not an observed SDK retry count.

metrics.scope: Human AWS pause/verify/resume/final-convergence experiment.
metrics.comparison_semantics: Measured human AWS pause/verify/resume/convergence result.

decision_signals.statement: The Phase 7 isolation case emitted two claims and both human-reviewed claim/citation support judgments were false.
decision_signals.interpretation: This is retained as a citation-attribution/grounding failure signal; the supporting lab records that the required isolation evidence was retrieved while the model cited an adjacent chunk.

decision_signals.statement: The bounded two-model experiment matched the Phase 11 quality result but added model calls, tokens, latency and derived inference cost, so it was not retained as the default reasoning topology.
decision_signals.interpretation: Successful execution does not justify retaining additional agent topology without a predeclared measurable benefit.

decision_signals.statement: AgentCore Runtime was retained only as a disabled-by-default optional lab target and not as the default OpsLens reasoning runtime.
decision_signals.interpretation: Managed hosting evidence is retained without converting a bounded successful experiment into default architecture authority.

decision_signals.statement: The bounded Inspector discovery returned zero coverage records and zero finding records in the measured account, Region and time window.
decision_signals.interpretation: A measured zero-record API result is retained evidence for that read only; it is not proof of zero runtime exposure or zero vulnerabilities.

non_comparable_pairs.reason: Different frozen datasets and support semantics; similar labels do not authorize numeric comparison.
Managed runtime transport includes a hosting boundary and is not direct Bedrock provider latency.
Managed runtime transport and in-process offline protocol timing are different surfaces.
In-process protocol timing and AWS API client elapsed time are different workloads.
Security-regression coverage count is not reasoning quality.
Control-coverage count is not reasoning quality.
Not-applicable cloud cost cannot be compared to a derived managed-runtime experiment cost.
An unmeasured cost cannot be compared to a derived experiment cost.
An explicitly unmeasured hybrid cost cannot be compared to a derived inference cost.
A configured delivery retry budget is not an observed execution metric.
Inference-only cost and total hosted-experiment cost have different component boundaries.

interpretation_boundaries: zero runtime records != zero runtime exposure
